```python
def _find_path(net, cap):
    # returns the list of arcs from SS to TT (in forward order) or None
    dist = net.dist; pi = net.pi; to = net.g.to; cost = net.g.cost
    v = net.TT

    while v != net.SS:

        visited.add(v)
        found = -1
        for i in _in_arcs(net, v):

                    rc = cost[i] + pi[u] - pi[v]
                    if dist[v] == dist[u] + rc:
                        found = i; break
        if found < 0: return None
        arcs.append(found)
        v = to[found ^ 1]
    arcs.reverse()
    return arcs
```
